title: [Bug]: ValidationError for RunCompletionEvent
body:
### Describe the bug

When "reflection_with_llm" is used for the chat's summary and openai is not used, I get a "ValidationError":
`Input should be a valid string`. 


### Steps to reproduce

```python
from autogen import LLMConfig, ConversableAgent
model_name = "claude-3-sonnet-20240229"
llm_config = LLMConfig(api_type="anthropic", model=model_name)
agent1 = ConversableAgent(
    name="Agent1",
    llm_config=False,
)
agent2 = ConversableAgent(
    name="Agent2",
    system_message="You are a helpful assistant.",
    llm_config=llm_config,
)
response = agent1.run(
    agent2,
    max_turns=1,
    message="What is the capital of France?",
    summary_method="reflection_with_llm",
)
response.process()
```

### Model Used

claude-3-sonnet-20240229

### Expected Behavior

Not to raise.

### Screenshots and logs
